title: session-fidelity-reconciler-and-heatmap-exporter
author: Priya Khatri
description: Motivation: production workloads show intermittent distributional drift that degrades our benchmark fidelity; existing runners sample sessions but do not provide a reconciliation step to make replay cohorts stable across runs. This PR introduces two coordinated components: (1) a Session Fidelity Reconciler which ingests sequential run metadata and produces stable replay cohorts by checkpointing representative session slices and de-duplicating noisy user actions, and (2) an Aggregated Heatmap Exporter that consumes reconciled cohorts and emits a compact heatmap-style telemetry artifact (JSON+proto-lite) summarizing token-level density, sequence-length buckets, and KV-cache reuse hotspots. Changes: implemented a reconciliation pipeline (reconciler/ dir) that performs sliding-window similarity hashing, deterministic bucketing, and checkpoint snapshots; added exporter (reporting/heatmap_exporter.py) that generates per-run artifacts plus an index for cross-run diffing; added CLI tooling and unit tests; expanded the benchmark runner to optionally use reconciled cohorts and to tag runs with cohort-id for downstream traceability. Why unique: unlike previous sample-and-run patterns this PR focuses on making the same workload selection reproducible across noisy upstream sources and on producing a compact artifact that is easy to diff and visualize in dashboards. Tests & validation: included end-to-end integration harness that runs the reconciler on a synthetic noisy-session corpus (10k sessions) and validates that the cohort Jaccard similarity across two independent reconciliation runs is >= 0.95 for the median cohort and stable for sequence-length buckets; benchmarked the reconciler CPU cost at ~0.08 vCPU-s per 1k sessions and verified exporter output size reduction of ~6x vs raw session dumps. Rollout plan: feature gated behind --use-reconciled-cohorts; default off. Will run in shadow mode on the benchmark-lab CI for 2 weeks before flipping. Related work items: Linear ENG-1921 (cohort tooling), ENG-2090 (heatmap viz), SUP-321 (customer incident that motivated better reproducibility). Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] CI build, [x] docs: added short README and CLI help, [x] telemetry metrics and tracing spans. Follow-ups: add dashboard ingestion job to convert heatmap artifacts into time-series for the Console and a lightweight viewer in the perf portal.
